verdict.rationale: Weaviate's own GitHub README lists Kubernetes as a first-party installation and deployment option alongside Docker and Weaviate Cloud. Its replication docs describe multi-node clusters with high availability, which supports production use. However, the pack never names an official Helm chart or operator, so how the Kubernetes deployment is packaged is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an official Helm chart or Kubernetes operator, production Kubernetes deployment docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can deploy to production on Kubernetes with an official Helm chart or operator

citations.quote: Weaviate offers multiple installation and deployment options: Docker, Kubernetes, Weaviate Cloud
Weaviate allows data replication across a multi-node cluster by setting a replication factor > 1. This enables a variety of benefits such as high availability
